① Random Forest — pillar importance Build first

Trains on every backtest trade with the 6 pillars + 15 enrichment fields as features, target = 5-day return. Outputs feature_importances_ and per-pick predicted returns.
Benefit: Right now your composite-score weights are hand-picked (tech 25 + cat 20 + rs 25 …). RF tells you which pillars actually predict return. Re-weight based on evidence.

② XGBoost + SHAP — per-pick explainability Build second

XGBoost typically beats RF by 1-3pp R². SHAP values give per-feature contribution to each prediction — every pick justifies itself.
Benefit: Composite score 88 says "this is good" but not WHY. SHAP shows exactly which factors pushed it up vs down. You can judge: do I trust the reasoning?

③ Bayesian hierarchical — forest plot Already 60% done

Already shipped Beta-Binomial setup pooling. Full forest plot adds 95% credible intervals visualized — the WIDTH tells you sample-size confidence.
Benefit: Pocket Pivot raw 33% (n=3) — is that real or noise? Forest plot shows credible interval [22%, 65%]. Wide → wait for more data. Narrow → trust the point.

Notice Pocket Pivot's wide band [22-71] vs Trend Continuation's tight [38-54]. Same problem (estimate WR), very different confidence. You'd kill VCP Breakout (whole CI below breakeven) but not Pocket Pivot (CI straddles breakeven — needs more data).

④ Contextual Bandit — adaptive setup sizing Practical RL alternative

Per (regime × setup) cell, maintains Beta(α, β) posterior. Picks size_multiplier ~ Beta sampled. Learns over time which cells deserve more capital.
Benefit: Right now setup_score_multiplier is hardcoded (Trend Cont. ×1.08, Near-VCP ×0.95). The bandit learns the right value per cell from live outcomes, automatically. Self-correcting allocation.

⑤ NLP Earnings Tone — guidance-aware predictor Highest visibility

Sends earnings transcripts to Claude/OpenAI for structured analysis. Returns guidance_tone, demand_signal, margin_outlook, macro_concerns. Combined with quant beat predictor.
Benefit: Companies that BEAT estimates but issue WEAK guidance often sell off. Pure number models miss this. NLP catches "China headwinds" or "softer guidance" before the market reacts. Real edge: BEAT+RAISE → +35% avg, BEAT+LOWER → -2% avg.
